requirements.statement: The upgrade audit contains a once-only authoritative matrix for executable docs/KEEL_UPGRADES.md requirements, with corrected classifications and evidence, while contextual or superseded material is distinguished.
The active upgrade roadmap is the sole authoritative top-level roadmap and contains P0–P7, their reviewed dependencies and safety contract, plus D1 explicitly deferred and non-prerequisite.
Completed bounded implementation slices, overlapping plans, and benchmark plans remain preserved as historical evidence but are no longer active execution authority.
No implementation-bearing file is changed by this reconciliation.
